“这正是问题所在，面对他的时候你会失控。失去冷静的判断，一心只想杀死对方。指挥员被情感所左右，这是军事行动的大忌。”唐坤厉声道，“到时候你会不惜一切来除掉他，哪怕付出几支小队的代价你也想除掉格罗斯。但实际的问题的是，我们不能损失过多的队员。因为这是一次公司对新人的考核，而你这样做这会影响到小队的考核成绩。而小队的成绩将会影响所有人的前途命运。”
赵建飞沉默了一会儿，抬头道，“那么，我以普通队员的身份加入。”
“这更不行，这是在作弊。”唐坤摇头道，“你想过没有，一旦被查出来。那么公司的董事会就会认为我们在故意欺瞒他们。银狼为我们所尽的一切努力都白费了。事情的严重程度，甚至会影响到他。而这么多年，米先生一直是我们中国籍佣兵在公司保持势力的关键。”
赵建飞一拳打在厚重的墙上，厉声喝道，“但是，面对格罗斯，我无法做一个旁观者。你知道么，直到今天我依然能够感到建业的血溅在我脸上的那种温热，我还记得那种感觉，那种撕裂心肺的痛。”
“我理解，我也是建业的朋友。”唐坤低声道，“但这是规矩。你不能出现在现场，但是你可以坐镇指挥中心，为我们提供作战信息。我答应你，如果有可能的话，我会亲手杀了格罗斯。你知道，被我盯上的人，通常也活不了多久。”说完他拍了拍赵建飞的肩膀，无声地从他身边走过。
林锐神色一动，连忙拉着正在偷窥的秦奋，蹑手蹑脚地从上层的教官区域溜了回来。就在他们刚一离开，唐坤就走了出来。
回到了宿舍，秦奋把门关上了，大口地喘着气，“好险，要不是溜得快，差点被唐坤发现了。”
林锐却皱眉道，“秦奋，你刚才听出点什么了没有？”
“好像是他们在争一个指挥权什么的。对了，还有就是我们些人要对抗一个很强的佣兵团队。那个团队好像还和赵疯子有仇。”秦奋想了想道。
林锐压低声音道，“是的，而且这是一次对我们能力的实战考核。其结果足以影响他们所有人的命运。”
“是啊，我听出来了，这好像是跟他们在晨星公司的地位有关系。”秦奋点头道。
“不但是这样，而且事关我们所有人。表面上，赵建飞他们三个人是负责这个训练营的。但实际上，这个训练营，以及他们三个人都得听那个米先生的。这个人是所有中国籍佣兵在晨星公司的核心人物，一荣俱荣，一损俱损。”林锐沉吟道，“而且我听他们的意思是，如果我们这次考核失败，将会导致训练营被裁撤。”
“如果是这样的话，那我们呢？”秦奋突然脸色变得难看了起来，有些紧张地道，“不会像金浩山那样消失吧？”
林锐皱眉在房间里踱了几步，突然转身道，“如果你的晨星公司的高层，你会任由我们这些人离开么？虽然我们知道的不多，但是这个基地，以及晨星公司其他的一些情况，我们多少都有一些了解。在这种情况下，他们放任我离开的机会有多少？”
秦奋的脸又白了，他低声道，“你是说他们也许会除掉我们，灭口？”
“这到不一定，毕竟这么做有很大的风险，而且米歇尔那一关也不好过。不过他们完全可以派我们去执行一些高度危险的任务，佣兵本来就是高度危险的职业，如果死在任务途中，就没有什么好抱怨的。而且米歇尔也找不出理由来反对。”林锐看着秦奋道。
“你说得我都有些害怕了。不过，我们还能怎么办？一纸合同，早就买断了我们的生死。”秦奋耸耸肩故作轻松地笑道。
“合同买断的只是五年而已。”林锐低声道，“虽然是你生命之中最黄金的一段，但并不是全部。我们还有机会。只要我们熬过这五年，一切就还有机会再来。所以我们必须活下去，哪怕再艰难，我们也要熬过去。”
秦奋正要说话，宿舍的门却被推开了。赵建飞站在门外，他冷冷地看着房间里这两个人。
秦奋立刻识趣地闭嘴不谈了。

"That's exactly the problem. When you face him, you will lose control. You will lose your calm judgment and only want to kill the opponent. Commanders are swayed by emotions, which is a taboo in military operations." Tang Kun said sternly, "When the time comes, you will do whatever it takes to get rid of him, even if you spend a few small guns. You also want to get rid of Gross at the expense of the team. But the actual problem is that we cannot lose too many players, because this is the company's assessment of new members, and if you do this, it will affect the team's assessment results, and the team's performance will affect everyone's future."
Zhao Jianfei was silent for a while, then raised his head and said, "Then, I will join as an ordinary team member."
"This is even worse, this is cheating." Tang Kun shook his head and said, "Have you ever thought about it, once we are found out, the company's board of directors will think that we are deliberately deceiving them. All Silver Wolf's efforts for us will be in vain. The seriousness of the matter will even affect him. And for so many years, Mr. Mi has been the key to our Chinese mercenaries maintaining their power in the company."
Zhao Jianfei punched the thick wall and shouted sternly, "But when it comes to Gross, I can't be a bystander. You know, to this day I can still feel the warmth of Jianye's blood splashing on my face. I still remember that feeling, the pain that tore my heart and lungs."
"I understand, I am also a friend of Jianye." Tang Kun whispered, "But this is the rule. You cannot appear at the scene, but you can sit in the command center and provide us with combat information. I promise you, if possible, I will kill Gross myself. You know, the people I target usually don't live long." After that, he patted Zhao Jianfei on the shoulder and walked past him silently.
Lin Rui's expression changed, and he quickly pulled Qin Fen, who was peeping, and crept back from the instructor's area on the upper floor. As soon as they left, Tang Kun walked out.
After returning to the dormitory, Qin Fen closed the door and gasped, "It was so dangerous. If I hadn't slipped away quickly, I would have been discovered by Tang Kun."
Lin Rui frowned and said, "Qin Fen, did you hear something just now?"
"It seems like they are fighting for a command or something. By the way, some of us have to fight against a very strong mercenary team. That team seems to have a grudge against Crazy Zhao." Qin Fen thought for a while.
Lin Rui lowered his voice and said, "Yes, and this is a practical assessment of our abilities. The results are enough to affect the fate of all of them."
"Yes, I heard it. It seems to be related to their status in Morningstar Company." Qin Fen nodded.
"Not only that, but it also affects all of us. On the surface, Zhao Jianfei and the others are in charge of this training camp. But in fact, this training camp and the three of them have to listen to Mr. Mi. This man is the core figure of all Chinese mercenaries in Morning Star Company. They will be prosperous and suffer losses." Lin Rui pondered, "And I heard what they mean is that if we fail this assessment, the training camp will be abolished."
"If that's the case, what about us?" Qin Fen suddenly turned ugly and said nervously, "You won't disappear like Jin Haoshan, right?"
Lin Rui frowned and walked around the room for a few steps, then suddenly turned around and said, "If you were the top management of Morning Star Company, would you let us people leave? Although we don't know much, we have some understanding of this base and other situations of Morning Star Company. In this case, what are the chances that they will let me leave?"
Qin Fen's face turned pale again, and he whispered, "You mean they might get rid of us and silence us?"
"This is not necessarily true. After all, there are great risks in doing so, and Michelle's experience is not easy. But they can definitely send us to carry out some highly dangerous tasks.Mission, mercenary is a highly dangerous profession. If you die during the mission, there is nothing to complain about. And Michelle couldn't find any reason to object. Lin Rui looked at Qin Fen and said.
"What you said made me a little scared. But what else can we do? A piece of contract has already bought out our life and death. "Qin Fen shrugged and smiled pretending to be relaxed.
“The contract buyout is only for five years. Lin Rui whispered, "Although it is the most golden period of your life, it is not everything." We still have a chance. As long as we survive these five years, there will be a chance for everything to happen again. So we must survive, no matter how difficult it is, we must get through it. "
Qin Fen was about to speak when the dormitory door was pushed open. Zhao Jianfei stood outside the door and looked at the two people in the room coldly.
Qin Fen immediately shut up and stopped talking.
